item.title: Church Swearing
item.description: Sometimes you want to call someone an idiot. You can do that. “You’re an idiot.” Clear, efficient, done. But sometimes you want more. You want to reach for something stranger. Something with a bit more architecture. “You lard-faced grass-prowler.” That lands differently. It’s the same insult but someone put work into it. Church swearing is taking the fuck out of a sentence and dressing it up like it has manners. The words sound elevated.
